typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATE_ENTERED as string,
		CASE_NUMBER as string,
		WORKTYPE as string,
		AMOUNT as string,
		INVESTIGATOR_NAME as string,
		ERROR_CATEGORY as string,
		ERROR_TYPE as string,
		INPUT_OPERATOR as string,
		REPAIR_REJECT as string,
		VERIFICATION_COMMENTS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Load_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		ERROR_TYPE as string,
		INPUT_OPERATOR as string,
		DATE_ENTERED as string,
		WORKTYPE as string,
		INVESTIGATOR_NAME as string,
		CASE_NUMBER as string,
		AMOUNT as string,
		REPAIR_REJECT as string,
		ERROR_CATEGORY as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		VERIFICATION_COMMENTS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ERROR_TYPE,
		INPUT_OPERATOR,
		DATE_ENTERED,
		WORKTYPE,
		INVESTIGATOR_NAME,
		CASE_NUMBER,
		AMOUNT,
		REPAIR_REJECT,
		ERROR_CATEGORY,
		Load_Date,
		VERIFICATION_COMMENTS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
